verdict.conclusion: AdamW is scale-invariant: a constant per-task gradient factor is a numerical no-op (rel diff ~1e-7, i.e. float32 noise). Only the time-varying part of AdaTask's factor can affect training. Since the AU is an EMA that settles, the historical implementation (grad.mul_(f) then AdamW.step) is expected to be近-inert in steady state. A genuine per-task learning rate must be applied POST-preconditioner (per-param-group lr, or scaling the update).
